sentence: Group members each pick one spending limit from four fixed amounts ($15, $20, $25, $30), and the tool shows vote counts and the middle pick.
use_when: A group needs to agree on a spending limit for a gift exchange
Everyone should pick one price from a short fixed list
You want to see the middle choice and who has not picked yet
dont_use_when: The group needs to split a bill or share a cost between people
Options are free text or a custom amount rather than fixed prices
The group needs to draw names or assign who gives to whom

blanks: Exchange Sunday the 14th at the lounge
